caption:
Your textarea doesn't need JavaScript. Hidden CSS #1: 3 old hacks you can delete today. 1. Auto-grow textarea → field-sizing: content (Chrome & Edge 123+) 2. Manual
in headings → text-wrap: balance 3. Rebuilt checkboxes → accent-color Which one goes in your next PR? Comment 1, 2 or 3. Send this to your frontend teammate. Save this for later.
alt: Before and after slides: 5 lines of JavaScript replaced by field-sizing content, manual br tags replaced by text-wrap balance, and a rebuilt checkbox replaced by accent-color.
